cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pressed the lift button twice, so I've pressed it four times. Good: we can order it for the shopping and us together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I pressed twice because it's stuck. We're walking up eight floors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the stairs today. Excellent, we can cancel the gym and do the full climb every evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: With all these shopping bags? I'll have to stop on every landing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, intervals. You set the pace and I'll copy it. We can cross the personal trainer off the budget too.

reason: Turn misunderstood lift operation into economical exercise routine; B rest stops shape the routine rather than a generic slogan.
